samples: This module takes a parcel description (weight, destination market of domestic, Europe or international, and order total) from the host application as JSON and returns a quote as JSON with the shipping cost, estimated delivery in business days, and whether shipping is free. The cost is a flat rate per destination (4.90 domestic, 9.50 Europe, 19.90 international) plus 2.50 for each started kilogram beyond the first, and delivery takes 2, 5 or 10 business days respectively. Only domestic orders of 50.00 or more ship free, and the module is pure (no network, file or other access), so it is safe to call at every checkout, though the rates, threshold and delivery times are fixed in the code rather than configurable.

This module is a pure pricing calculator that a host application calls at checkout. It takes a parcel (weight, destination market of domestic, Europe or international, and order total) and returns a quote with the shipping cost, the delivery time in business days (2, 5 or 10 depending on destination), and whether shipping is free. Cost is a flat rate per destination (4.90, 9.50 or 19.90) plus 2.50 for each started kilogram beyond the first, except that domestic orders of 50.00 or more ship free. It does no I/O and needs no permissions, parcels can be read from JSON and quotes written as JSON, and parcels with a non-positive weight or a negative order total are rejected when built, so it is safe to embed.

This module is a pure, side-effect-free pricing library for a web shop's host application: given a parcel's weight, destination (domestic, Europe or international) and order total, it returns a quote with the shipping cost, the delivery time in business days and a free-shipping flag. Each destination has a flat base price and delivery time (2, 5 or 10 business days), plus a surcharge for every started kilogram beyond the first, and domestic orders at or above the free-shipping threshold ship free regardless of weight. Parcels and quotes convert to and from JSON, so a host can call it at checkout with little glue, though the rates and the threshold are fixed in the code, so any pricing change means editing the module.

This module is a pure, side-effect-free pricing calculator that a host application calls at checkout: given a parcel's weight, destination (domestic, Europe or international) and order total, it returns a quote with the shipping cost, the delivery time in business days, and whether shipping is free. Cost is a flat rate per destination plus a fixed surcharge for each started kilogram beyond the first. Domestic orders at or above the free-shipping threshold ship free, and delivery takes 2, 5 or 10 business days depending on destination. Parcels and quotes convert from and to JSON, so it is easy to embed, and the documented examples match the rules. One thing to verify is that the free-shipping branch uses a whole-number zero where a decimal cost is expected, which the language's no-implicit-conversion rule may reject.

This module is a pure shipping-quote calculator for a web shop's host application. Given a parcel's weight, destination (Domestic, Europe or International) and order total, it returns the shipping cost, the delivery time in business days (2, 5 or 10 depending on destination), and whether shipping is free. Cost is a fixed base rate per destination plus 2.50 for each started kilogram beyond the first, except that domestic orders of 50.00 or more ship free. It needs no network, file or other permissions, reads the parcel from JSON and returns the quote as JSON, so it is safe to call at every checkout, though the rates and the free-shipping threshold are hard-coded.
